0003.description: Rich walnut showcases bold grain and depth, framed by vibrant cherry and red padauk checkered stripes. A striking handcrafted board with a warm, graphic pattern and generous prep space.

0007.description: A bold end-grain cutting board pairing rich red padauk with warm limba for vibrant contrast. The chamfered edges add a crisp, tailored finish to this substantial everyday board.

0009.description: Rich red padauk and light limba create a striking two-tone end-grain pattern, finished with softly rounded edges. A durable, eye-catching board with a comfortable, refined profile.

0010.description: Crafted entirely from walnut, this end-grain board features a lively sporadic block pattern that highlights the wood's natural variation. Its deep tone and detailed grain make it both practical and distinctive.

0011.description: A dramatic walnut and padauk end-grain board with sweeping red accents that create a cosmic, flowing pattern. The richly figured surface gives this functional piece the presence of a display-worthy centerpiece.

0012.description: A compact walnut catch-all tray with a softly rounded rectangular shape and raised rim. Its warm grain and low-profile design make it ideal for organizing keys, jewelry, or other everyday essentials.
